D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Jim Costa leads by 21.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 55,100 votes; a one point swing is about 1,273 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +13.7 and D +29.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$939K cash against $18K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
